description: Decide whether a schema change breaks your clients, and which ones. Classifies every change by the audience it breaks: producers construct the payload, consumers read it. Adding a required field breaks senders; adding an enum value breaks readers. A change it cannot classify is reported as unclassified and never counted as safe. Pay 150000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

after.description: A JSON Schema using the supported keyword subset: type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, patternProperties, items, prefixItems, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, minLength, maxLength, pattern, format, minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, exclusiveMaximum, multipleOf, minProperties, maxProperties, nullable, allOf, anyOf, oneOf, not, $ref, $defs, definitions, title, description, default, examples, example, deprecated, readOnly, writeOnly. Patterns use a non-backtracking subset with no groups or alternation. $ref resolves inside the document only; a remote reference is refused rather than fetched. A keyword outside the subset is reported in not_examined rather than treated as satisfied.

before.description: A JSON Schema using the supported keyword subset: type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, patternProperties, items, prefixItems, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, minLength, maxLength, pattern, format, minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, exclusiveMaximum, multipleOf, minProperties, maxProperties, nullable, allOf, anyOf, oneOf, not, $ref, $defs, definitions, title, description, default, examples, example, deprecated, readOnly, writeOnly. Patterns use a non-backtracking subset with no groups or alternation. $ref resolves inside the document only; a remote reference is refused rather than fetched. A keyword outside the subset is reported in not_examined rather than treated as satisfied.

role.description: Who your clients are. producers for a request body they send, consumers for a response body they read, both when the artifact flows each way. Defaults to both.

name: json_schema_compatibility

by_audience.description: How many changes break producers and how many break consumers, counted independently.

compatible.description: The single field to branch on, for the stated role. False whenever anything was unclassified or the comparison was bounded.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of the input was not analysed, which is a different problem from input that is wrong.

not_examined.description: Named reasons anything was left unexamined: a bound reached, an unsupported keyword, an unresolvable reference, or findings beyond the listing cap.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: JSON Schema Compatibility
